title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday November 2026, (Tue, Nov 10th)
excerpt: Microsoft continues its AI-induced patch surge, addressing 1,260 different vulnerabilities this month. 68 of these vulnerabilities are considered critical. 167 of the vulnerabilities are Chromium issues affecting Microsoft Edge.
publisher: SANS Technology Institute, Internet Storm Center

title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday for November 2026 — Snort rules and prominent vulnerabilities
excerpt: Microsoft has released its monthly security update for November 2026, which includes 1328 vulnerabilities affecting a range of products, including 60 that Microsoft marked as "critical." Out of 60 "critical" vulnerabilities, 45 are remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities.
author: Cisco Talos
